workshopIntro: Kencho Group is a furniture workshop in Tbilisi. Our team measures, makes and installs — and works with your interior designer to carry the project through.
ownerAlt: Kencho Group’s owner walking through a completed interior

1.q: Can you work with my interior designer?
1.a: Yes. Send the drawings or renders on WhatsApp. Our team will review the project with you and your designer.

2.q: Can you furnish an entire space?
2.a: We make kitchens, wardrobes, storage and other interior furniture. Share the full project so the team can discuss the pieces together.

3.q: What should I send to get started?
3.a: A plan, a few inspiration photographs or a short description is a useful starting point. If you have drawings, send those too. The team will guide the next steps.
